discovery: This runtime's syscall process IDs differ from the procfs mount's IDs. Reading /proc/<Popen.pid>/stat is not a valid binding here.
implementation_change: Use libc clock_getcpuclockid with the actual unreaped child syscall PID and clock_gettime. No /proc PID lookup. Preflight the backend on self before launch; persistent unavailable child clocks fail closed.
unchanged_parent_CPU_stop_policy: declared cap minus max(1.5 seconds, 1 percent of cap)
unchanged_final_acceptance: strict finite nonnegative wait4 measurements after complete child termination, plus exit and launch/watchdog checks
